resources.string: No ATA on your Mac yet? Send yourself the download link, then open it on the Mac to install.
Open ATA on your Mac, tap \"Pair with a Mac\" below, and scan the QR code on the Mac\'s screen. No QR code? Click \"Pair a Phone…\" in ATA on the Mac.
Send the download link to myself
Open this link on your Mac to download ATA: %1$s
To send files to this Mac again, you\'ll need to pair it again.
In Photos or any app, tap Share and choose \"Send to Mac\". Your files go straight to your Mac.
Sent to \"%1$s\", used about %2$s of mobile data
The camera can\'t be opened right now, so the QR code can\'t be scanned. Close any other app using the camera and try again.
Looking for \"%1$s\" nearby. Keep your phone next to the Mac.
Pairing with \"%1$s\". This takes a moment.
Paired with \"%1$s\". From now on, tap Share in any app and choose \"Send to Mac\".
Want to send a photo to your Mac now to try it?
Your phone will ask next. Choose the option that allows it, usually \"Allow\" (the wording may differ slightly on your phone). ATA uses this to find your Mac, never to locate you.

Your phone will ask next. Choose the option that allows it, such as \"Allow\" or \"While using the app\" (the wording may differ slightly on your phone). This Android version requires it to find Bluetooth devices; ATA doesn\'t use your location.
ATA needs \"Nearby devices\" to find your Mac. Tap \"Open Settings\", then turn on Nearby devices under Permissions.
ATA needs location access to find your Mac. Tap \"Open Settings\", then turn on Location under Permissions.
We suggest allowing it, usually with \"Allow\". Then you can see the progress in a notification and cancel any time, even after leaving this screen.
Turn on Bluetooth so ATA can find your Mac.
This Android version needs Location turned on to find Bluetooth devices. ATA doesn\'t use your location.
Waiting for your Mac \"%1$s\" to answer
Not on the same Wi-Fi, so sending over the internet. This may be slower…
Your Mac \"%1$s\" is joining this phone\'s Wi-Fi for a moment. It goes back to its own Wi-Fi when done…
Sent to your Mac \"%1$s\" (used about %2$s of mobile data)
Other files are still being sent
Wait until they\'re done, then share your new files.
Can\'t find your Mac nearby. Make sure ATA is open on the Mac, and bring your phone next to it.
Can\'t find \"%1$s\" nearby. Make sure ATA is open on that Mac, and bring your phone next to it.
This Mac isn\'t paired with this phone. Tap \"Pair with a Mac\" to pair again.
This Mac has removed its pairing with this phone. Pair again.
This QR code no longer works. Click \"Pair a Phone…\" on your Mac again to show a new one.
Your Mac is receiving files from another phone. Wait a moment, then send again.
ATA on your Mac needs an update. On the Mac, open %1$s to download the latest version.
This Mac\'s pairing doesn\'t match. Remove the pairing on both, then pair again.
Your Mac didn\'t accept this one. Send again.
Your Mac is out of space. Free some up and send again.
Your Mac can\'t find the save folder. Choose one again in ATA on the Mac.
Couldn\'t reach your Mac. Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi as the Mac, then try again.
Your Mac couldn\'t join this phone\'s Wi-Fi. Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi as the Mac, then try again.
Your phone can briefly make a Wi-Fi just for your Mac. While sending, the Mac leaves its current Wi-Fi (no internet on the Mac for that moment) and goes back to it automatically when done.
Android will ask for a permission next: ATA needs it to briefly turn on your phone\'s Wi-Fi for your Mac.
Without that permission, ATA can\'t send using your phone\'s Wi-Fi.
Sending stopped partway. Files that were already sent stay on the Mac.
Some files didn\'t arrive completely. Send them again.
This file can\'t be opened, so it can\'t be sent. Go back to the app and share it again.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on and send again.
ATA doesn\'t have \"Nearby devices\" access, so it can\'t find your Mac. Turn it on in Settings.
This isn\'t an ATA pairing QR code. Scan the QR code that ATA shows on your Mac.
Lost the connection to your Mac. Move closer and send again.
Something went wrong. Send again. If it keeps happening, update ATA on both.
Your Mac isn\'t nearby. Make sure ATA is open on the Mac and Bluetooth is on, then bring your phone closer.
Allow \"Nearby devices\" so ATA can find your Mac.
Bluetooth is off, so ATA can\'t find your Mac.
Can\'t look for your Mac right now. Try again in a moment.

Open ATA on the Mac, click \"Pair a Phone…\", then scan the QR code on the Mac with this phone. No ATA on the Mac yet? Open %1$s on the Mac to download it. Your files stay here; once paired you can send them right away.
ATA uses the free software below, made by other people. As they ask, their original notices follow. It\'s long, so scroll down to read it all.
Scan the QR code with the camera

Your phone will ask next. Choose the option that lets ATA use the camera, such as \"While using the app\" (the wording may differ slightly on your phone). The camera is only used while you scan the QR code; nothing is saved or sent.
The camera is needed to scan the QR code on your Mac. Tap \"Open Settings\", then turn on Camera under Permissions.
Fit the QR code on your Mac inside the frame
